positioning: AI Done Right makes it easy to build AI the most efficient and appropriate way — the right model, the right method, and the right cost for each task, instead of sending everything to the most expensive frontier model. Teleon is the runtime that makes any capability efficient (descend it to the cheapest bounded path that still meets the bar); Baltor is the engine that makes it trustworthy; the Open*Hubs are the open store of building blocks both consume.
mission: Most teams build AI the expensive, one-size-fits-all way. AI Done Right makes the efficient, appropriate way the EASY way: write a capability in plain language and the system chooses the cheapest, most appropriate path — deterministic rules and cheap models before frontier LLMs, the frontier reserved for supervision — governed end to end.
brand_laws: Teleon governs what becomes EFFICIENT — the cheapest bounded path (the descent brain).
